findings.issue: Missing explicit verification of GPU measurements and privacy evidence
findings.impact: Potential non‑compliance with performance and privacy requirements
findings.recommendation: Add a dedicated step to capture and archive GPU metrics and privacy logs, and link them to the corresponding requirement IDs.

findings.issue: No mention of handling clock drift or time zone differences in repository adapter
findings.impact: Could lead to inconsistent timestamps across environments
findings.recommendation: Document and test clock normalization logic, ensuring all timestamps are stored in UTC and validated against a reference clock.

findings.issue: Lease renewal test only covers exact 30s and 90s boundaries, not sub‑second variations
findings.impact: Edge cases may cause premature lease expiration or stale state
findings.recommendation: Extend tests to cover sub‑second boundaries and verify graceful handling of near‑expiry renewals.

findings.issue: No explicit test for ship placement overlap detection beyond seeded property tests
findings.impact: Risk of undetected overlapping ships in rare configurations
findings.recommendation: Add deterministic overlap scenarios to the test suite and assert rejection.

findings.issue: Quality tier selection criteria not documented
findings.recommendation: Define and document the mapping between quality tiers and asset/feature flags.

findings.issue: Chat rate window not quantified (e.g., messages per minute)
findings.impact: Potential abuse or denial of service via chat flooding
findings.recommendation: Specify a numeric rate limit and include a test that verifies enforcement.
